channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about David Nwaba | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about David Nwaba from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rudy Gay on DeMarcus Cousins, John Wall, David Nwaba
item.description:
Rudy Gay on helping Wall, Cousins & Nwaba overcome Achilles injuries:

“I just want people to do well and have control of their careers. (It's) an injury where people have written you off and told you you can’t come back or it’s career-ending. But if I can do it, they can do it.”

Rudy Gay on DeMarcus Cousins, John Wall, David Nwaba, Jan 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Daryl Morey on David Nwaba
item.description:
Morey on David Nwaba:

“David we think has really good potential. You guys have a good sense of how we play now, and David Nwaba we think fits that very well. Unfortunately, given the rules, we had to cut someone.”

Daryl Morey on David Nwaba, Jul 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @KellyIkoNBA.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Jonathon Simmons, David Nwaba
item.description:
“Every so often a club will catch lightning in a bottle with a Jonathon Simmons of the world or a David Nwaba, but a lot of good local, high school, college talent that these guys deserve and want a shot,”

Dennis Lindsey on Jonathon Simmons, David Nwaba, Sep 22, 2018. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Luke Walton on David Nwaba
item.description:
Serena Winters:Luke Walton on @David Nwaba:

“It doesn’t seem like he cares about anything other than playing defense and winning.”

Luke Walton on David Nwaba, Apr 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Luke Walton on David Nwaba
item.description:
“Some of them aren’t available right now. (Nwaba’s) been good. But we have to decide if we want to wait or look at someone else.”

Luke Walton on David Nwaba, Mar 10, 2017. Source: Orange County Register.
